_about: Curated CORDIS DET queries for Cluster 3 (Civil Security) call subjects, keyed by call title (= the Call node's `name`). Reviewed/hand-written (phrase-quoted domain terms scoped with contenttype=project) because auto-generated queries mis-tag ambiguous subjects. The tagger fetches each query, aggregates the funded projects' EuroSciVoc research fields, and writes them onto the matching Call nodes. Edit freely; re-run tagging to apply.
